name: Extended dwell time makes onboarding-only screening insufficient

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed defensive research finding; adjudication and independent dispositive force require separate evidence.

ttps: Continue identity, access, SaaS, endpoint, and code-repository monitoring well after onboarding; a clean first week does not resolve worker risk.
caveats: The public summary presents one 122-day value for both categories; separate North-Korean-IT-worker-only sample size and distribution are unspecified.

statements: Mandiant reports that the 2025 median dwell time for both cyber-espionage and North Korean IT-worker incident categories was 122 days, versus a 14-day global median across its investigations.

sources.support: Mandiant reports that the 2025 median dwell time for both cyber-espionage and North Korean IT-worker incident categories was 122 days, versus a 14-day global median across its investigations
